unit: characters of instruction text one PR run loads into its main session
note: limit = the ceiling check.py enforces now; target = where the route has to end up. Lower a limit whenever a route shrinks; raising one needs a reason in the PR. polish, review, compat-check, and unslop run in subagents (go, branch-pr, and monitor launch them), so their bodies are not in any route.

headless.note: an unattended run settles the PR instead of watching it, and reviews low-risk changes before the PR

merge.note: go --draft or --merge, or a finding review deferred

playbook.note: a route that follows a pstack playbook reads work's playbooks.md and one playbook (831 to 4,466 characters; feature.md stands in)

ticket.note: a ticket reference in the request or branch, in a repo whose owner set an environment file (git config gbase.conventions); the file itself is the user's and is not counted

ui.note: a change to what a user sees
